xna-type.name: Artist
xna-type.summary: Provides access to artist information in the media library.
xna-type.remarks: The Artist class provides information about an artist, including the artist's Name , Albums , and Songs . You can obtain an Artist object through the ArtistCollection.Item indexer and the Album.Artist and Song.Artist properties.

property.name: Albums
property.summary: Gets the AlbumCollection for the Artist.
property.remarks: The returned AlbumCollection contains all albums in the device's media library that are associated with this Artist .

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the Artist.

property.name: Songs
property.summary: Gets the SongCollection for the Artist.
property.remarks: The returned SongCollection contains all songs in the device's media library that are associated with this Artist .

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Artist is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Artist is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .
